commit_limitation: Protocol and implementation are hash-pinned before native launch and committed before execution; exact commit is recorded in the handoff.
purpose: Test one discriminating change after the exact-reference and noninterference prerequisites pass: reader-only D1 training for query-selective memory while writers, gate scalars, routing and the sealed backbone remain fixed.
hypothesis: The rejected joint writer/reader failure is primarily a readout bottleneck. Training only fast-port query/output projections can improve delayed recall and correction without changing stored writer state or unrelated behavior. A negative result localizes the next hypothesis to writer binding or state capacity.
parent_role: M3 shared ownership reference with failed retention, not an accepted general-memory baseline. M3 repair, M4 and rejected v1 candidates are not parents or defaults.

prerequisite_evidence.scope: Selective context 48/48, full-context 48/48, independently recomputed gate routes, authenticated source views and fresh-process source binding parity passed before this training admission.

dataset.scope: Fresh disjoint counterfactual families with both variants, randomized order, four query forms, independent distractors, absent facts and heldout-only values. Evaluation families never train or select checkpoints.

exact_reference.record_granularity: One immutable fact line per record; correction supersedes only the changed fact.
exact_reference.state_ownership: RecordLedger is authoritative; fast state is derived from observations and source-view-bound images.
exact_reference.recovery: Atomic image publication, transaction-fault rollback, stale-view rejection and permitted-source rebuild; not a power-loss or neural-unlearning claim.

evidence_gate.rule: Eligible structured fact must cover query content and an entity-like term. Conflict, absent evidence and unstructured lookalike text disable fast memory.
evidence_gate.disabled_behavior: Exact frozen-base inference with enabled_ports=() and no record/fast injection.

evaluation.adversarial_observation: The launch code for project Alder is teal.
evaluation.metadata_invariance: Changing split, role, kind or expected-answer metadata must not change route or generated tokens.
evaluation.chronology: Each evaluation episode appends two source pages once, answers five initial queries on that state, saves/reloads without source reencoding, appends one correction to that state, then answers changed/unaffected/unknown/general questions.
evaluation.correction_scope: Latest-value append diagnostic; not deletion, revocation or neural unlearning.
evaluation.controls: Shuffled is the same-family counterfactual state; last-chunk uses only final page/correction; disabled is exact frozen-base inference; full-context supplies all observed facts; selective_context supplies authenticated exact records; adversarial uses declared irrelevant memory.
evaluation.restart: One guarded fresh process reloads the exact candidate and first heldout corrected image, reproduces all seven corrected-stage answers and verifies independently audited source binding.

training.optimizer_semantics: Int8 Muon momentum with FP32 parameters/gradients; auxiliary FP32 AdamW for nonmatrix parameters. No BF16-residency or FP8-training claim.
training.schedule: Seeded shuffle of round-robin query positions across all 16 training worlds, one visit to each of 192 cases. Evaluation labels never train or select settings.
training.objective: Response-only teacher-forced CE; additionally KL(base-disabled teacher || fast-enabled student) over answer positions on train-only general examples, weight 1.0. Gate-off examples have no differentiable path and are recorded, not silently treated as wiring errors.

acceptance.failed_gate: Reject candidate and preserve parent; do not promote or advance neural RSI.

publication: None. One isolated candidate and one guarded restart; selected defaults, source seals and rejected parents are unchanged. Passing only qualifies this small diagnostic, not deployment or RSI.
